source.title: Senior Delegate Announcement - Asia West and South (October 2021)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Senior Delegate in Asia West and South: Akash Rupela.

Akash’s term had been extended previously but as noted on the rights and duties of WCA Senior Delegates available in [WCA Motion 09.2021.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2021.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf), a new appointment had to be made at this time. There were no other candidates who applied for the position.

We wish Akash Rupela the best of luck in continuing to fulfill his duties in the region.

You can find his candidacy document [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sQvPoVemtQ_J0iPS8NP7dWaUHQB3I7vM?usp=sharing).

translation.title: 高级代表任命公告：西亚和南亚（2021 年 10 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，西亚和南亚地区的高级代表为 Akash Rupela。

Akash 的任期此前已获延长，但根据 [WCA 动议 09.2021.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2021.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf)中关于 WCA 高级代表权利与职责的规定，此时须重新进行任命。本次没有其他人申请该职位。

祝 Akash Rupela 继续顺利履行该地区的职责。

他的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sQvPoVemtQ_J0iPS8NP7dWaUHQB3I7vM?usp=sharing)查看。
